QuestionStmt.S: The power ($P$) is supplied to rotating body having moment of inertia '$I$' and angular acceleration '$\alpha$'. Its instantaneous angular velocity is

Solution.S:
Torque acting on the body: $\tau = I \alpha$.

Power is given by: $P = \tau \omega$, where $\omega$ is the instantaneous angular velocity.

Substitute $\tau = I\alpha$:

$$P = (I\alpha) \omega$$

$$\omega = \frac{P}{I\alpha}$$

Final Answer: $$\boxed{\frac{P}{I\alpha}}$$

Hence, the correct option is D.
